title: Broken importer glTF
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in stable version 4.7 and later.
The importer works correctly in stable version 4.6 and earlier.
All versions were downloaded from Steam.

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon (TM) R5 M330 (0x00006660) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-27.20.20913.2000) - Intel(R) Pentium(R) CPU  N3700  @ 1.60GHz (4 threads) - 7.84 ГиБ memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When attempting to load any model, the import proceeds normally, but a second import follows, causing the engine to crash (even in Recovery mode).

Fun fact: if you import a model in stable-4.6 and then open the project in stable-4.7, the model works correctly.

### Steps to reproduce

Download gltf model from internet
Create new project on Godot in compability mode
Drag model and drop to project window
Wait ending import and crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

